name: Visibility-Based Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Visibility-Based Geometry Pruning of Neural Plenoptic Scene Representations
Visibility-Based Geometry Pruning of Neural Plenoptic Scene Representations (3DGS variant)
definition: A pruning technique that removes occluded 3D Gaussian kernels during the optimization pipeline to create a more compact, 'hard' geometry representation, concentrating alpha values into remaining kernels.
